observations.limits: Sampled summed process-tree RSS counts shared pages in each process; phase CPU uses cumulative owned process CPU deltas. Finite windows neither prove nor exclude a leak, unique physical RAM or thermal behavior.

operational_findings.positive_retained_rss_observed: Opened phase median grows approximately 34/48 MiB; closed phase median grows approximately 114/133 MiB between cycles one and eight.
operational_findings.interpretation: Finite sampled retention does not classify or exclude a leak. The first cycle also includes occupied-origin failure/retry and page reload; allocator/process warmup and receiver overhead are included.
operational_findings.attribution_limits: Two independently owned Qt applications are not shared-session multi-view. Summed RSS double-counts shared pages; no unique-RAM, GPU, thermal or native-platform inference. Knowledge heartbeats occur after readiness, not during synchronous provider parsing.

preliminary_restricted_controls: Initial Node child-pipe runs inside the restricted execution context did not deliver usable captured output and are excluded. All four final controls pass with local IPC enabled; no global socket or OS configuration was changed.
